xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2608-14-17">mtshan nyid mdor bstan pa dang yon tan rgyas par bshad pa 'di gnyis la|_mkhas pa'i skye bo dam pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">slob dpon seng ge bzang po</rs>s <rs type="work">'grel</rs> pa dag tu ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang chos sku so sor byas nas sku bzhir bshad pa ni mtshan nyid gzhi dang mtshan nyid dam|_yon tan dang de'i rten so sor dbye ba mi 'thad pa la sogs pa'i rigs pas gnod cing |_<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">rje btsun</rs> nyid kyis chos kyi sku mtshan nyid lnga dang yon tan lnga la sogs pa gsungs pa dang |_sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi|_|sku bsdus par ni shes bya ste|_|sku gsum dag gis rang gzhan gyi|_|don 'di rten dang bcas par bstan|_|zhes sku'i grangs nges pa sgrub pa gsungs pa la sogs pa'i lung mang po dang yang 'gal la|_lus rnam par gzhag pa'i chos sku zhes bya ba'ang 'bras bu sangs rgyas [- 398 -]     kyi sa'i spyi'i mngon rtogs su gsungs kyi|_sku bzhi par bzhed pa gtan ma yin pas rtsa ba'i rjod byed du ma zhugs pa'i phyir rang dga'i bshad pa kho na ste|_des na 'dir mdo sbyor ji ltar mdzad pa ltar sku gsum nyid don ji lta bar blta'o|_| <rs type="work">'grel</rs> par spyir 'chad pa ni de lta na don dam pa chos nyid kyi sku yin pas chos zhes bya ba tha snyad pa'i sgra mi 'grigs so snyam pa la|_rkyen phyis pas zhes gsungs pa ste|ta dang tal zhes bya ba nyid kyi sgra mi mngon par byas pa'o|_|</seg></TEI>
